description: This file contains unit tests for socket waiter functionality in the starboard namespace, including tests for socket readiness, callbacks, and edge cases like sockets already being ready.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterWaitTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for socket waiter tests with parameterized socket address types.

classes.name: PairSbSocketWaiterWaitTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for socket waiter tests with pairs of socket address types.

classes.name: CallbackValues
classes.description: Structure to hold callback invocation data during socket waiter tests.

classes.name: AlreadyReadyContext
classes.description: Context structure for testing sockets that are already ready before waiting.

methods.name: TestSocketWaiterCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when socket is ready, updates callback values and wakes up waiter.

methods.name: FailSocketWaiterCallback
methods.description: Callback that triggers test failure if called unexpectedly.

methods.name: GetAddressType
methods.description: Returns the socket address type parameter for the test.

methods.name: GetServerAddressType
methods.description: Returns the server address type from the pair.

methods.name: GetClientAddressType
methods.description: Returns the client address type from the pair.

methods.name: AlreadyReadyEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread entry point that writes data to socket to simulate readiness.

methods.name: WakeUpSocketWaiterCallback
methods.description: Callback that wakes up the socket waiter.

methods.name: AlreadyReadySocketWaiterCallback
methods.description: Callback that reads data from socket, signals thread to write more, and adds another read callback.
